- `campaign_members` (3 cols; joins: `campaigns`, `customers`)
- `campaigns` (4 cols; joins: `campaign_members`)
- `cities` (4 cols; joins: `customers`, `regions`)
- `customers` (8 cols; joins: `campaign_members`, `cities`, `orders`, `regions`, `returns`, `tags`)
- `events` (3 cols; joins: _(none)_)
- `monthly_rev` (2 cols; joins: _(none)_)
- `order_items` (5 cols; joins: `orders`, `products`)
- `orders` (5 cols; joins: `customers`, `order_items`)
- `orders_flat` (10 cols; joins: _(none)_)
- `products` (5 cols; joins: `order_items`, `ratings`)
- `regions` (2 cols; joins: `cities`, `customers`)
- `returns` (4 cols; joins: `customers`)
- `time_spine` (1 cols; joins: _(none)_)

# `customers`
Columns: id, name, region_id, city, tier, credit, discount, tags
Measures: _(none)_
Aggregations: _(none)_
Joins to: cities, regions

# `regions`
Columns: id, name
Measures: _(none)_
Aggregations: _(none)_

args.message: Regions ranked by revenue (sum of order amounts). Credit total is the sum of credit limits for all customers in the region, including those with no orders. Orders whose customer has no known region are left out.
